'''Jamie Beck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Coruscant Civil War]] on 6 November 1999 with Tatooine (?) deck, according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d99">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-07-coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-nyd99/ coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-ny], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 7 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-07-coruscant-civil-war-6-nov-99-syracuse-nyd99/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
